# Deck3 First Law — Real-World Images Before Scientific Illustration V1

**Effective:** 2026-10-13  
**Status:** Mandatory user-directed **figure-source priority** for future Deck3 and MSE-thesis illustrative-image / infographic production. This is a production standard, not a modification of canonical physics, approved slide text, research findings or the 13-color governance.

## FIRST LAW — Real-world-grounded, unified-purpose illustration

> **Before drawing or generating a scientific equipment illustration, find, actually inspect and assess relevant real-world images of the physical objects and configurations. Use authentic, documented real-world imagery in the final unified, slide-purpose composition as much as scientifically appropriate and legally permitted. If direct reuse is not authorized or physically misleading, create an original source-grounded depiction; do not invent hardware or substitute generic imaginary equipment.**

**Priority order for each physical-equipment asset:**

1. Read the slide's **one main message, three actual support bullets and scientific boundaries**; determine the precise visual purpose.
2. Search and visually inspect **real-world photographs first**, preferably primary manufacturer equipment photographs/manuals, official utility/operator photos, credible experiment/case documentation, or user-owned photos. Inspect engineering schematics and peer-reviewed figures for physically specified connectivity and operating mechanisms, not photographic appearance alone.
3. Record object, equipment **type/technology**, cooling and connection configuration, view/crop needs, known/unknown attributes, provenance URL or user-provided origin, author/rights/attribution status and **how the image actually supports the planned composition**.
4. **Reuse authentic pixels where permitted** and helpful; preserve natural colors/materials (cars, vegetation, roads, metals, instruments). If licensing is absent/unclear, **do not embed the third-party photograph** or closely reproduce protected artwork; create independently composed original equipment art grounded in the inspected real-world reference. Explicitly disclose which method was used.
5. Integrate only the **minimum meaningful physical objects into ONE coherent illustration** corresponding to that slide's purpose. No repeated template montage, broad stock imagery, arbitrary desert scene or unrelated accessories; never stitch ten slides into one image.
6. Overlay physically exact ports, boundaries, typed AC/DC power arrows, heat transfer, external heat forcing, measurement and conditional controls as **separate precisely authored scientific geometry**. Prefer independently editable text/math/arrow layers in Canva/PowerPoint, not AI-rendered pseudo-technical text.
7. Gate release by scientific, source/licensing, engineering and projected-size visual review. Mark **PROVISIONAL/OPEN/NOT_RUN** honestly when a source, permitted usage, installation configuration, or physics-based relation is not verified.

This first law is a **priority for physical illustration production**, not a requirement to add photographs to abstract research-method diagrams, evidence matrices, equations, actual model-derived plots or timelines. When physical photography does not materially improve a specific slide's message, use scientifically exact native editable diagrams. **No forced real photograph, invented photo, or decoration merely to meet a quota.**

## Mandatory hierarchy — fidelity over visual appeal

- **Scientific truth is non-negotiable:** First-law physics, conservation, true installed topology and units always override photographic attractiveness.
- **Source image ≠ engineering evidence:** A transformer photo does not establish an installed relay trip, fan, oil-cooling mode, EVSE topology, system interdependency, numerical value, observed flow or validation.
- **Reference photography ≠ licensed reuse:** Searching or viewing does not license copying; distinguish `PHOTO_EMBEDDED_PERMISSION_VERIFIED`, `SOURCE_GROUNDED_ORIGINAL`, and `NO_PHOTO_JUSTIFIED`.
- **Hardware specificity:** Avoid drawing an oil-immersed ONAN transformer fan unless the actual selected type supports one; do not invent grid-to-car wiring, V2G, charging protocol details, fan count, heat curves or connector configuration.
- **No scientific promotion:** P→T_e and T_e→P thermal mechanisms remain separately candidate/unqualified until admitted; shared ambient heat is external forcing, not proven interdependency.
- **Visual governance:** White canvas/panels; exact Deck3 13 authored sRGB colors; ASU Maroon headings and restricted small ASU Gold accents; authentic photographed physical colors exempt; Times New Roman for authored labels, 16:9 insertion-ready asset geometry and high-resolution PNG + original SVG where suitable.
- **Canva-ready output:** An **independent, insertable image**, not a complete slide. `N` requested means `N` independently designed and individually exported images. Preserve full deck text, the actual per-slide three points, separate native slide labels/equations/citations, and approved presentation variants.

## Required per-asset evidence log

Produce one record for each physical illustration:
- `slide_id`, `main_message`, `three_source_bullets`, `visual_question`, `component_ids`.
- `image_reference_url_or_user_origin`, `provider/author`, `actual_visual_inspection_status`, `physical_equipment_match`, `photograph_reuse_rights`, `permitted_use_or_justification`.
- `source_use_method` = `PHOTO_EMBEDDED_PERMISSION_VERIFIED`, `SOURCE_GROUNDED_ORIGINAL`, or `NO_PHOTO_JUSTIFIED`.
- `embedded_real_photo_count`, `source_visual_characteristics_transferred`, `physical_connections_and_evidence_ledger`, `independent_QA_status`.
- If photo count is zero for an equipment-focused figure, **explicitly report why**; no generic “real-world-referenced” label without actually inspecting a real image.
- If a slide is abstract, record `NO_PHOTO_JUSTIFIED` with the slide-specific scientific rationale and choose precise vector/mathematical graphics.

An automated provenance schema can check declared completeness but **cannot establish that a web image was actually inspected, copyrighted reuse is permitted, or physics is verified**. Require a reviewer for those facts.

## Worked source-selection example — Slide 5

**Message:** System-of-systems architecture of the eight selected Power and Electrified Transportation physical components.

- Inspect real distribution transformer + feeder + charging-station + vehicle images separately; identify feasible actual equipment variants and visually supportable connections.
- Build one **unified purpose-designed** architecture image, not four unrelated floating photo cards.
- Keep P1 and P2 inside the Power boundary, T1 and T2 inside Electrified Transportation. P3 protection/monitoring, P4 transformer cooling, T3 EVSE cooling, T4 vehicle HVAC are actual associated/conditional components, not four series charging stages.
- Distinguish AC P1→P2→T1, DC T1→T2; demonstrate no undocumented curtailment or temperature-dependent control. If hardware configuration is unidentified, label it a **generic grounded example**, not the thesis installation.
- Source technical labels, role-specific arrows and citations remain independently editable; image of real equipment never overrides engineering topology.

## Integration and change control

Read this law before `DECK3_INDIVIDUAL_CANVA_READY_ILLUSTRATION_PROTOCOL_V1.md`, `DECK3_VISUAL_REFERENCE_RETRIEVAL_PROTOCOL_V1.md`, `DECK3_AI_IMAGE_GENERATION_STANDARD.md`, scientific-infographic, scientific-diagram and Deck3 generation procedures.

**Changed:** future physical-figure reference selection, image provenance, licensed reuse decision and visual QA.  
**Not changed:** frozen thesis title/objectives/evidence, 8/10/13/14-slide routing, ASU/Deck3 existing palette, scientific assertions, existing generated figures or prior QA results.

**Release rule:** Cannot certify an equipment illustration as real-world-grounded merely because a search was run or a photo was viewed. Evidence log, separate rights check, verified output files and manual scientific inspection remain mandatory.
